specials.title: Red Dog Specials
specials.description:
Soup:
Tomato Bisque... 6 (cup) or 8 (bowl) ~ A delicious blend of fire roasted tomatoes, vegetables, spices and cream. Topped with crispy croutons.

Appetizers and Salads:

Loaded Deviled Eggs ... 12 ~ Classic deviled eggs, but with a twist! A creamy, savory filling topped with crispy bacon pieces, chives and a pickled jalapeño slice.

Fried Calamari ... 15 ~ Tender squid rings and tentacles, lightly dusted in breader, then deep-fried.
Japanese Kani Salad ... 13 ~ Shredded imitation crab, cucumbers, crisp red peppers and crunchy toasted panko. Tossed in a creamy sesame mayonnaise dressing and served on a bed of sliced cucumbers.

Entrées:
Captain's Seafood Platter ... 40 ~ Shrimp, flounder, oysters and clam strips, all lightly breaded and fried.
Served with hush puppies, French fries and coleslaw.

Pork Ribeye ... 25 ~ Herbed, grilled pork ribeye steak topped with cranberry/jalapeño relish and served with mashed potatoes and roasted carrots & jalapeños.

Dessert:
Sopapillas... 8 ~ Deep fried flour tortilla triangles, dusted with cinnamon sugar, drizzled with honey and dusted with powdered sugar

LUNCH SPECIALS: Friday / Saturday 11 AM-3 PM
Italian Hero Sub (Hot or Cold) ... 16 ~ Sliced pastrami, salami, Black Forest ham and provolone cheese. Topped with lettuce, tomato, onion, hot cherry peppers, and finished with our house red wine vinaigrette.
Tomato Bisque & Grilled Cheese Sandwich ... 13 ~ Our creamy, savory tomato bisque alongside a crispy, buttery melted cheese sandwich on sourdough.

specials.title: Red Dog Piney Creek Specials
specials.description:
Soup: Zuppa Toscana ... 6 (cup) or 8 (bowl)
A creamy Italian-American soup featuring Italian sausage, potatoes, and kale in a rich broth.

Appetizers and Salads: 
Cranberry Jalapeño Dip ... 12
Cranberries, spicy jalapeños, honey, scallions and
seasonings atop warm cream cheese served with
pita bread bites.

Fried Calamari ... 15
Tender squid rings and tentacles, lightly breaded, then deep-fried.

Entrées:

Captain’s Seafood Platter ... 40
Shrimp, flounder, oysters and clam strips, all lightly breaded and fried. Served with hushpuppies, French fries and coleslaw.
Pork Ribeye ... 25
Herbed, grilled pork ribeye steak topped with cranberry/jalapeño relish and served with sautéed parsley buttered new potatoes and roasted carrots & jalapeños.
Lasagna ... 18
Made with a creamy ricotta cheese mixture, savory meat sauce and mozzarella cheese. Served with garlic bread.

LUNCH SPECIALS
Friday & Saturday 11 AM-3 PM
Egg Salad Sandwich ... 12
Chopped hard-boiled eggs mixed with mayonnaise, mustard, relish and seasonings on toasted bread. Served with chips.
Fried Buffalo Chicken Sandwich ... 13
Buttermilk, dill pickle brined chicken breast, breaded, fried, and tossed in buffalo sauce. Served on a toasted bun with dilly blue cheese
aioli and lettuce. Served with fries.
